Subject: Kickoff: MSA redline + order form mapping for Coupa activation

Hi Jordan / Laura,

Thanks for the intro call last week. We need to get the MSA and Order Form finalized so our procurement team can finish Coupa activation. Attached our initial annotated redline (MSA_v3) and a short proof-of-insurance PDF.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Redwood accepts Coupa PO line splitting (we sometimes send multi-line POs).
- PO acknowledgement SLA — we typically require 48h ack in our portal; please confirm Redwood's capability.
- Order-form field mapping: we need a canonical crosswalk so our Coupa integrator can map your order fields to our internal GL/code values.

Can you route redline coordination to Legal + Ops and share an updated MSA with consolidated comments? Procurement would like to lock terms before end of month.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Sr. Procurement Lead, MediRidge Health

Samira / Jordan — I reviewed MSA_redline_v3 and consolidated comments inline. High-level legal notes:

- Liability cap: MediRidge requested a per-claim unlimited carve; we can accept a single aggregate cap tied to fees on the Order Form but need the Order Form fee to be final before we commit.
- Data processing: our standard DPA applies; anything specific to MediRidge’s regional controls should go into the DPA addendum.
- Audit / access: propose sample language that requires 30 days notice and limits scope to security controls — see redline.

Open question for Ops: can we agree on a PO-ack window of 72 hours instead of 48? Legal prefers a slightly longer window for initial activation to avoid immediate breach triggers during the onboarding wave. Also need confirmation on EDI acceptance behavior (line-splitting, partial-ship acknowledgements).

Next steps:
1) Ops to confirm PO-ack SLA and EDI behavior (Kim).
2) If Ops can accept 72h ack, I will update the MSA redline and produce a clean version for signature via DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Samira / team — technical ops notes below. Copying Mateo who will run the Coupa integrator call.

ED I / PO behavior:
- We support multi-line POs and accept PO line splitting; our EDI parser will normalize to single PO header with multiple line items. Partial shipments are supported and will generate PO Ack per line.
- PO acknowledgement SLA: our default is 72 hours for new customer activations to allow for provisioning and QA. We can expedite to 48 hours for accounts with reserved Dedicated capacity but that requires a contractual SLA and commitment.

Order Form field mapping (summary):
- Required: buyer_org_id, order_number, currency, billing_code (GL), ship_to_location_code, requested_delivery_date.
- Optional but recommended: internal_project_id, cost_center, requester_email.
- Tax/GL handling: MediRidge should provide a mapping CSV for their GL codes; Mateo and I will validate against our OrderForm_field_crosswalk.xlsx template.

Risks / notes:
- If MediRidge insists on 48h ack without SLA, Ops flags potential missed acknowledgements during cutover; recommend 72h during activation then 48h post-stabilization with SLA.
- For EDI format we prefer ANSI X12 850 / 855 flows; if Coupa is sending XML PO we need the integrator to confirm contentType and an example payload.

Proposed next step: Mateo to schedule the integrator technical sync (30 minutes) for Thu 10/15 at 10am PT. Samira — please confirm availability and share an example PO payload if you have one.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Integrations | Redwood Inference
